attrs.author: Thinking Machines Lab
attrs.summary: Inkling - Thinking Machines multimodal (audio+vision) MoE. Inkling is the first open-weights model released by Thinking Machines Lab. It is a 975B Mixture-of-Experts with 41B active parameters, trained natively across text, image, and audio. Built as a broad generalist foundation for fine-tuning, with controllable thinking effort.
